info.title: Agentkit API
info.description: This document describes the Agentkit v2 API. The /api/v1 API is legacy and intentionally undocumented. Developer documentation: https://agentkit.ai/docs/developer

get.description: Returns channel availability and connection state. Accepts a workspace API key or an explicit user session.
Returns one channel with its saved override, effective instructions, and settings revision.

patch.description: Replaces the channel instruction override and action allowlist. The email channel takes its instructions from the email settings, so it accepts only `instructionMode: "inherit"` with a null `instructionOverride`; anything else is rejected with 400. The help page and email channels remain in limited rollout and need a rollout-approved user session plus an eligible plan. WhatsApp and Center Stage are available to any caller with agent access on an eligible plan. The web and Instagram channels are available to any caller with access to the agent.
Optimistically updates widget or iframe enablement using a SHA-256 revision of the raw agent settings.

get.description: Returns the owner-facing Center Stage presentation, entitlement state, and settings revision. Requires an agent-owner session.

patch.description: Optimistically replaces Center Stage settings. Requires an agent-owner session and eligible plan.

get.description: Lists custom API action definitions, including the request configuration. Requires a user session: a stored configuration can hold literal downstream credentials, so an account API key never reads it.

post.description: Creates a disabled server action. Test it before enabling it with the status route.

get.description: Returns one custom API action definition, including the request configuration. Requires a user session for the same reason as the list route.

patch.description: Updates an action using its loaded updatedAt value.

delete.description: Deletes an action using its loaded updatedAt value.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a custom API action
patch.description: Enables only a tested action with valid variables, destinations, secret references, and plan access.

get.description: Lists secret names and metadata. The response never contains plaintext or ciphertext.

put.description: Encrypts a secret value and returns metadata only. The value is write-only.

get.description: Lists non-archived widgets. Requires a rollout-approved user session.

post.description: Creates a widget draft. Requires a rollout-approved user session.
Validates and imports a portable widget package as a draft.

get.description: Returns one widget draft.

patch.description: Optimistically replaces a widget draft using its loaded updatedAt value.
Sets a widget to draft or archived.

post.description: Compiles and publishes the loaded draft using optimistic concurrency.

get.description: Lists immutable versions newest first.
Returns one immutable compiled widget version.

post.description: Creates a draft copy of one widget.

get.description: Returns the portable .widget package without action credentials.
Returns a bounded agent inventory for an MFA-verified super-admin user session with agent membership. Available on every plan.
Lists Backstage sessions in reverse creation order.
Returns a session and its latest 40 user and assistant messages.
Returns one proposed change and its review display.

post.description: Approves or rejects one proposed change after write-access checks.

get.description: Returns saved progress for the session owner. Requires super-admin and MFA; available on every plan.

delete.description: Cancels this run. Already approved ingestion jobs continue.

post.description: Admits one durable request for one shared message credit. Retry with identical clientMessageId and content to recover its run. Poll the run endpoint; disconnecting does not cancel work.

get.description: Accepts an account API key with API access and agent ownership, or an explicit user session with the existing email rollout and MFA. Reads remain available when email is disabled, including discarded email. Returns lightweight summaries in activity order. Cursors bind agent, status and since filters.

Accepts an account API key with API access and agent ownership, or an explicit user session with the existing email rollout and MFA. Reads remain available when email is disabled, including discarded email. Returns all stored bodies, normalized headers, immutable ingestion disposition, discard reason and draft revisions. Reading does not mark read. Repeated historical headers retain their stored joined representation.

post.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Only discards the reviewed inbound/draft snapshot. Stale state returns 409.

Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Restores review visibility without generation, actions or delivery. Retired drafts stay retired.

Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Explicitly requests a draft. It never auto-sends and rejects system verification mail.

Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Forwards stored message text without attachments. Reuse submissionId after an ambiguous timeout and read back the outcome.

get.description: Accepts an account API key with API access and agent ownership, or an explicit user session with the existing email rollout and MFA. Reads remain available when email is disabled, including discarded email. Lists pending drafts in generation order.

Accepts an account API key with API access and agent ownership, or an explicit user session with the existing email rollout and MFA. Reads remain available when email is disabled, including discarded email.

patch.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Atomically compares the reviewed revision and rejects newer inbound mail or a claimed send.

post.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Approves the reviewed draft revision. Repeated delivery uses the same draft identity. Already sent is a success; ignored and empty are not delivered.

Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Atomically enables and provisions an inbox. address is an exact initial local part on the configured inbound domain. Different choices for an existing inbox conflict.

Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Preserves inbox address, routing and history.

get.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup.

patch.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Patches supplied fields only. signatureHtml currently stores plain text. Empty text clears the signature.

get.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup.

put.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Delivers a code to the reply mailbox without returning it. Replaces the existing single inbox reply routing.

delete.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Clears routing and verification while preserving inbox and history.

post.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Consumes a six-digit mailbox code under existing expiry and attempt limits.

get.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup.

post.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup. Adds an exact sender preference for future automated mail to reach review. It never grants tools, generation or automatic replies.

delete.description: Requires an explicit user session, API access and the existing email rollout. MFA must be satisfied. Writes require settings.manage permission (or personal ownership) and email entitlement, except disable, removal, discard and restore cleanup.

get.description: Checks whether the v2 API is available. This endpoint does not require authentication.
Lists the agents owned by the workspace in reverse creation order.

post.description: Creates an agent in the workspace. Empty or null URL values are stored as null.

get.description: Returns one agent owned by the authenticated workspace.

patch.description: Updates an agent name or URL. At least one field is required.

delete.description: Deletes an agent owned by the authenticated workspace.

200.description: Confirmation that the agent was deleted.

post.description: Sends a message to an agent. Assistant text uses Markdown. Streaming is enabled by default; set stream to false to receive one JSON response.

200.description: A Server-Sent Events stream when stream is true, or one JSON assistant message when stream is false.

get.description: Lists conversation summaries. The source filter defaults to API v2 conversations.
Exports up to 20 conversations per page with every non-tool message ordered from oldest to newest.

200.description: A page of conversations with complete transcripts.

get.description: Returns one conversation and its complete non-tool transcript for the selected source.
Lists non-tool messages in a conversation selected by source. Omitted source includes api_v2 and API Playground tests. Messages within a page are ordered from oldest to newest.

patch.description: Sets positive or negative feedback on an AI assistant message, or clears feedback with null.

200.description: The assistant message with its updated feedback.

post.description: Regenerates an AI assistant reply from its preceding user message and removes the selected reply and later messages.

200.description: A Server-Sent Events stream when stream is true, or one regenerated assistant message when stream is false.

post.description: Claims a pending client action once and streams the assistant continuation.

200.description: Assistant continuation after the tool result, always as Server-Sent Events.

get.description: Lists API v2 conversations associated with one caller-supplied end-user ID.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only api_v2 is accepted because user IDs are written by API v2 chat.

200.description: A page of conversations for the end user.

get.description: Lists the text, Q&A, URL, and uploaded-file sources attached to an agent.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: Restricts results to one stored source type.

post.description: Adds a titled text snippet to the agent training sources.
Adds question variants and their answer to the agent training sources.

post.summary: Add or retrain a URL source
post.description: Queues one public HTTP or HTTPS URL for indexing, or retrains it when it already exists.

202.description: The URL processing job was queued.

post.description: Creates signed storage upload URLs for one to 20 supported files.

200.description: Signed upload details for each file.

post.description: Validates previously uploaded files and queues them for processing.

202.description: The file processing job was queued.

delete.description: Deletes one training source identified by its UUID.

200.description: Confirmation that the source was deleted.

get.description: Lists contacts in reverse creation order, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring search.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across external ID, email, name, and phone.

post.description: Upserts one contact by external ID. Omitted profile fields preserve stored values; null or empty values clear them. Custom attributes accept JSON values.
Bulk upserts one to 1,000 contacts and keeps the last row for duplicate external IDs.

200.description: Counts of processed and deduplicated rows.

get.description: Lists captured leads in reverse submission order with optional inclusive datetime bounds.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound as an ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound as an ISO 8601 datetime.

get.description: Returns the current AI settings as a bare object. Unset settings produce an empty object.

patch.description: Updates the model, instruction preset, or instruction prompt. At least one field is required.

get.description: Returns the current title, language, position, branding, and conversation settings.

patch.description: Updates design fields and returns the complete persisted settings object. At least one field is required.

get.description: Returns the current security settings as a bare object. Unset settings produce an empty object.

patch.description: Updates privacy, rate-limit, or allowed-domain settings. At least one top-level field is required.

get.description: Returns the current notification settings as a bare object. Unset settings produce an empty object.

patch.description: Updates daily conversation, daily email, or quota alert preferences. At least one field is required.

get.description: Returns the current training settings as a bare object. Unset settings produce an empty object.

patch.description: Enables or disables automatic retraining for the agent.

get.description: Returns document counts, the last training time, and the most recent active training job.

post.description: Starts retraining for indexed web URLs. If no web source exists, no job is created.

200.description: No web sources were available to retrain.

get.description: Returns the connection, all four automations, conversation starters, and persistent menu. An unconnected agent returns connected false.
Returns one configured Instagram automation or its default configuration.

patch.description: Saves the complete automation configuration, changes its status, or does both. At least one field is required. The accepted config shape is fixed by the key in the path: respond_to_dms takes RespondToDmsConfig, comment_to_dm takes CommentToDmConfig, story_leads takes StoryLeadsConfig, story_mentions takes StoryMentionsConfig.

200.description: The saved automation status and configuration.

get.description: Lists every saved row of a many-instance automation kind (comment_to_dm or story_leads), oldest first. Each instance carries its own id, status and configuration; at most one live instance may target a given post or story and at most one live catch-all may exist per kind. The legacy /automations/{key} route keeps addressing the oldest instance.

post.description: Creates a new row of a many-instance automation kind from a complete configuration. Without a status the row is saved as a draft; status live validates the configuration and enforces live cardinality (409 INSTAGRAM_AUTOMATION_TARGET_TAKEN when another live instance already targets the same post or story, 409 INSTAGRAM_AUTOMATION_CATCH_ALL_EXISTS when a live catch-all already exists).

get.description: Returns one row of a many-instance automation kind by id. An id that belongs to another agent or another kind is a 404.

patch.description: Saves the complete configuration of one instance, changes its status, or both — the same rules as the legacy key route, applied to exactly this row. Status off is how an instance is retired; there is no delete. Going live enforces live cardinality (409 INSTAGRAM_AUTOMATION_TARGET_TAKEN / INSTAGRAM_AUTOMATION_CATCH_ALL_EXISTS).

get.description: Returns the saved draft and confirmed live conversation starters for the connected account.

patch.description: Saves starter prompts, changes their status, or does both. Publishing or clearing synchronizes with Instagram.

200.description: The stored and confirmed conversation starter state.

get.description: Returns the saved draft and confirmed live persistent menu for the connected account.

patch.description: Saves menu items, changes menu status, or does both. Publishing or clearing synchronizes with Instagram.

200.description: The stored and confirmed persistent menu state.

post.description: Checks the connected account permissions and returns the verification outcome and latest connection state.

get.description: Accepts an account API key with API access and agent ownership, or an explicit user session with the existing email rollout and MFA. Reads remain available when email is disabled, including discarded email. Returns the stored body, addresses, normalized headers and ingestion disposition. Reading does not change inbox state.

bearerAuth.description: Send the workspace API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

sessionBearerAuth.description: A Supabase user access JWT. Also send X-Agentkit-Auth: session.

RequestId.description: Unique request identifier. Include this value when contacting support.

OptionalSessionAuthMode.name: X-Agentkit-Auth
OptionalSessionAuthMode.description: Set to session when Authorization contains a Supabase user access JWT. Required when selecting session authentication; omit when using a workspace API key.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor returned by the preceding page. Replay it unchanged.

MessageId.name: messageId
MessageId.description: Positive numeric message ID serialized as a string.

AutomationInstanceKey.name: key
AutomationInstanceKey.description: A many-instance Instagram automation kind: comment_to_dm or story_leads. The singleton kinds have no instances.

ConversationMessageSource.name: source
ConversationMessageSource.description: Conversation source. Omitted source includes api_v2 and API Playground tests. all includes api_v2, widget, instagram and API Playground tests; native browser previews are excluded.

ConversationSource.name: source
ConversationSource.description: Conversation source. all includes api_v2, widget, instagram and API Playground tests. playground selects API Playground tests; native browser previews are excluded.

BadRequest.description: The request body, path value, or query value is invalid.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer API key is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The workspace plan does not permit the request or a quota was reached.

NotFound.description: The requested agent or resource was not found.

InternalServerError.description: The server could not complete the request.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current conversation or Instagram connection state.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is well-formed but its content cannot be processed.

TooManyRequests.description: The Backstage request was rate-limited or the concurrency limit was reached.

BadGateway.description: Instagram rejected or failed to confirm the change.

source.description: Where the value comes from. `trusted_email_or_model` lets a verified email address be substituted server-side and is accepted only on a scalar text parameter.

actionName.description: Tool name exposed to the model. Spaces become underscores and any other character outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_]` is stripped, so the value must contain at least one letter or digit.
Tool name exposed to the model. Spaces become underscores and any other character outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_]` is stripped, so the value must contain at least one letter or digit.
Tool name exposed to the model. Spaces become underscores and any other character outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_]` is stripped, so the value must contain at least one letter or digit.

instructionMode.description: The email channel accepts only `inherit`; every other channel accepts both.

channel.description: Playground classifies test chats separately. Continue with the same channel as the original conversation.

conversationId.description: Reference ID returned by a previous chat response. Omit it to start a new conversation.

pendingToolCall.description: Set when the reply paused on a client-side tool call; submit its result to the tool-result endpoint.

EventStream.description: Server-Sent Events containing message-start, text-start, Markdown text-delta, text-end, message-metadata, finish, optional error, and a final [DONE] sentinel. When the reply pauses on a client-side action the stream also emits a tool-call event with { id, name, arguments }; submit the outcome to the tool-result endpoint to resume the conversation.

content.description: Must contain non-whitespace text and encode to at most 262,144 UTF-8 bytes.

answer.description: Must contain non-whitespace text and encode to at most 262,144 UTF-8 bytes.

url.description: Public http(s) URL with a multi-label domain. A missing protocol is normalized to https before validation. URLs with credentials, and hosts that resolve to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, are rejected.

model.description: The stored model identifier. New values come from the Model enum; settings saved before a model was renamed can hold a historical identifier.

instructionsPreset.description: The stored preset. New values come from the InstructionsPreset enum.

language.description: Stored widget locale, normalized to one of en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, zh-tw. Null when unset or when the stored value is not a supported locale.

Widget locale. Canonical values: en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, zh-tw. Region and script subtags are normalized (en-US to en; zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-MO, and zh-Hant to zh-tw), underscores are treated as hyphens, and matching is case-insensitive. Any other language — including zh-Hans — is rejected. Null clears the setting.

oneOf.description: Legacy newline-delimited form. At most five nonblank lines of at most 140 characters each once trimmed; anything else returns 400 VALIDATION_INVALID_BODY. Prefer the array form, whose limits are machine-readable.

config.description: The complete configuration for the kind in the path: comment_to_dm takes CommentToDmConfig, story_leads takes StoryLeadsConfig.

Each key accepts exactly one config shape: respond_to_dms takes RespondToDmsConfig, comment_to_dm takes CommentToDmConfig, story_leads takes StoryLeadsConfig, and story_mentions takes StoryMentionsConfig. A config for the wrong key is rejected with VALIDATION_INVALID_BODY.
The complete configuration for the kind in the path: comment_to_dm takes CommentToDmConfig, story_leads takes StoryLeadsConfig. A config for the wrong key is rejected with VALIDATION_INVALID_BODY.

InstagramMenuItems.description: At most five items. Each id must be unique across the array after trimming; duplicates return 400 VALIDATION_INVALID_BODY.
